items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: And he used to get jobs for me, get me jobs over in Long Island. He had so much work that he couldn't do it himself, so he called on me.

ctx.x: Because I didn't come to New York until '28. And he used to get jobs for me, get me jobs over in Long Island. He had so much work that he couldn't do it himself, so he called on me. He did a lot of singing and he played old-time drums, but people loved it.
About how old was he? Was he much older than you?
